CveFindings.Name: Microsoft ASP.NET Core project templates vulnerable to denial of service
CveFindings.Description:
[CVE-2024-21319](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-59j7-ghrg-fj52): Microsoft ASP.NET Core project templates vulnerable to denial of service

Severity: MEDIUM

Affected dependencies:
  - Microsoft.IdentityModel.JsonWebTokens:5.6.0 (declared at packages.config:53, affected range < 5.7.0; patched )
  - Microsoft.IdentityModel.JsonWebTokens:5.6.0 (declared at packages.config:53, affected range >= 6.5.0, < 6.34.0; patched )
  - Microsoft.IdentityModel.JsonWebTokens:5.6.0 (declared at packages.config:53, affected range >= 7.0.0-preview, < 7.1.2; patched )

Recommended fix: upgrade to the first patched version listed above where available.

CweFindings.Name: Incorrect Conversion between Numeric Types
CweFindings.Description: When converting from one data type to another, such as long to integer, data can be omitted or translated in a way that produces unexpected values. If the resulting values are used in a sensitive context, then dangerous behaviors may occur.
CweFindings.Explanation: CatalogItemHiLoGenerator and CatalogDBInitializer convert SQL bigint sequence values to int without a range check. The catalog sequence is defined as bigint with a maximum of 9223372036854775807, so values beyond Int32 range wrap when used as catalog IDs.

CweFindings.Name: Incorrect Calculation
CweFindings.Description: The product performs a calculation that generates incorrect or unintended results that are later used in security-critical decisions or resource management.
CweFindings.Explanation: The route-provided page size and index are converted and used without range checks. `pageSize * pageIndex` can overflow in the paging query, and a zero pageSize causes division by zero when TotalPages is calculated, disrupting requests.

CweFindings.Name: Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime
CweFindings.Description: The product does not release a resource after its effective lifetime has ended, i.e., after the resource is no longer needed.
CweFindings.Explanation: UpLoadImageFromFile opens a FileStream with File.OpenRead and never disposes it after UploadFromStream completes. InitializeCatalogImages invokes this helper repeatedly, leaving file handles open.

CweFindings.Name: Missing Release of File Descriptor or Handle after Effective Lifetime
CweFindings.Description: The product does not release a file descriptor or handle after its effective lifetime has ended, i.e., after the file descriptor/handle is no longer needed.
CweFindings.Explanation: UpLoadImageFromFile opens a file handle using File.OpenRead but does not close or dispose the stream after uploading.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Password
CweFindings.Description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.
CweFindings.Explanation: The local SQL Server service supplies a fixed literal SA_PASSWORD in the committed Docker Compose override instead of resolving it from a secret source. The value is intentionally omitted here.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CweFindings.Description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
CweFindings.Explanation: A SQL Server credential is embedded as a fixed literal in the committed Docker Compose override at the SA_PASSWORD setting. The credential value is intentionally omitted here.

CweFindings.Name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
CweFindings.Description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
CweFindings.Explanation: Catalog item Name and Description are accepted from editable form fields in Edit.Save_Click (Edit.aspx.cs:69-70) and rendered through data-bound asp:Label Text properties without explicit HTML encoding in Details.aspx:16,23. This creates a stored cross-site scripting path.

CweFindings.Name: Improper Control of Resource Identifiers ('Resource Injection')
CweFindings.Description: The product receives input from an upstream component, but it does not restrict or incorrectly restricts the input before it is used as an identifier for a resource that may be outside the intended sphere of control.
CweFindings.Explanation: UploadImage accepts the request itemId and uploaded file name from the client (PicUploader.asmx.cs:40-41). ImageAzureStorage.UploadTempImage concatenates the parsed itemId and untrusted HttpPostedFile.FileName into the Azure blob identifier (ImageAzureStorage.cs:89,93), allowing the caller to select blob resource names outside the caller-specific scope.
